component.name: MarkView
component.summary: A powerful, read-only Markdown viewer for Linux with rich GitHub-style rendering

description.p: MarkView is a high-performance, read-only Markdown viewer designed specifically for Linux desktop environments. Built with GTK 4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0, MarkView delivers authentic GitHub-flavored document rendering within an elegant, GNOME Human Interface Guidelines compliant user interface.
By focusing exclusively on reading and reference, MarkView eliminates the risk of inadvertent keystrokes modifying your source documents. Features include:

ul.li: Fast, hardware-accelerated rendering powered by WebKitGTK 6.0
Full GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) compatibility: tables, task lists, strikethrough, and GitHub alerts
Syntax highlighting for over 100 programming languages using Pygments
Mathematical expression rendering with KaTeX (inline and display equations)
Declarative diagram and chart visualization using Mermaid.js
Multi-layer security model with Bleach HTML sanitization and strict Content Security Policy
Interactive Table of Contents / Outline navigation sidebar
Automatic live reload upon file change using Linux inotify
Seamless adaptive light and dark theme switching matching system preferences
